{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Wraith''''' was a pair of two [[Marauder-class Assault Corvette/Legends|''Marauder''-class corvettes]] belonging to [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. The pirate corvettes, along with [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] and [[Heavy Lifter/Legends|Heavy Lifters]], attempted a [[Skirmish above Tinoon|raid]] at [[Tinoon Station]] hoping to steal some containers from the station. Before they arrived, [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] who was delivering a [[Viper probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] for [[Aeron Azzameen|his sister]] at the [[Zephry Asteroid field]], arrived at Tinoon Station just before the pirates did. When they did arrive, Tinoon Station's Security launched [[Planetary Defender starfighter|Planetary Fighters]] to hold the Pirates off. Ace then intervened and destroyed both corvettes repelling the raid.
